11: Story `P2-O` (`p2-o-integration-audit-cross-context-events-and-widgets`) delivers the cross-context integration between `com.example.app.audit` and the peer bounded contexts `com.example.app.iam`, `com.example.app.configuration`, `com.example.app.execution`, and `com.example.app.governance` inside `app/backend/`. It builds upon the physical persistence schema and immutability triggers in `V2__iam_and_audit_schema.sql` (`P1-B`), `V3__configuration_and_seeded_definitions.sql` (`P1-C`), and `V4__execution_and_governance_schema.sql` (`P1-D`), the Redis/S3/SAP infrastructure adapters (`P1-E`), the IAM/RBAC/SoD/View-As/onboarding foundations (`P2-A`, `P2-B`, `P2-C`), the configuration definitions/recipes/schedules/reference-table services (`P2-D`, `P2-E`), the execution run upload/worker/artifact/endorsement services (`P2-F`, `P2-G`), the universal governance ticketing engine (`P2-H`), the audit/notifications/dashboard APIs (`P2-I`), and the cross-context integrations in `P2-J`, `P2-K`, `P2-L`, `P2-M`, and `P2-N`. Governing requirements from `docs/agents-v0/requirements/p2-o-integration-audit-cross-context-events-and-widgets.md`, `docs/agents-v0/architecture.md`, `docs/agents-v0/design/system/context-map.md`, `docs/agents-v0/design/system/components/audit-notifications.md`, `ADR 0001` (`docs/agents-v0/adr/0001-modular-monolith-architect

saction after staging database writes and invokes `TransactionAspectSupport.currentTransactionStatus().setRollbackOnly()` (such as `409 EXECUTION_FREEZE_CONFLICT` emitting `GOVERNANCE_CUTOVER_FROZEN_CONFLICT`, `403 SOD_CONFLICT_DETECTED` emitting `GOVERNANCE_TICKET_SOD_BLOCKED` / `SOD_CONFLICT_REFUSED`, `403 AUTH_FORBIDDEN` emitting `AUTHZ_DENIED`, or `403 VIEW_AS_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN` emitting `VIEW_AS_MUTATION_BLOCKED`), an `AuditLogService.recordEvent` call that shares the outer rollback-marked JDBC transaction (`Propagation.REQUIRED`) would have its `INSERT INTO audit_log_entries` rolled back along with the domain table writes. Therefore, refusal audit events (`outcome == "DENIED"` or `outcome == "REFUSED"` or refusal `event_type` codes) must execute in an independent `Propagation.REQUIRES_NEW` transaction so the domain tables roll back cleanly while the refusal audit row is durably committed in `audit_log_entries`.
